chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'A man marries a woman upon the known dower and enters with her before he gives it to her.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should forward to her whatever little or much, unless there is for him a fulfillment from an asset; if an event occurs with him, it is paid from it, so there is no problem.'
ai.seo_question: Can a husband enter into marital relations before paying the full dowry to his wife?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that consummation before full payment of the dower is permissible provided the husband gives an initial portion or retains sufficient assets to cover the debt in case of death or incapacity. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on securing the wife’s financial rights (*haqq al-nisa*) while allowing flexibility in marital relations, reflecting the principle that the dower is a debt owed to the wife rather than a strict condition for the validity of the marriage contract itself.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man marries the woman upon the known dower. He copulates with her before he gives it to her’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should forward to her whatever little or more unless if there happens to be for him a fulfilment from an asset if there occurs with him an even (death) so it can be paid from it, so there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who marries a woman for a certain amount of mahr (dower) and goes to bed with her without paying anything.
He (the Imam) said, ‘He must pay in advance a little or more unless he has a certain asset which is enough to pay her mahr (dower) in case something happens to him, then it is not unlawful.’”
